about.title: Meet Jay Sauer
paragraphs: Green Gorge Construction is Jay Sauer's business. Jay is the owner and the craftsman, and your only needed contact from estimate to finish.
We serve the Oregon and Washington sides of the Columbia Gorge, and rural customers are welcome.
Estimates are free, and no job is too small.
